converting_recipes: Lead with the redesign visuals, not the ad-preview — this buyer's own customers judge them on the experience they can see (closer to Creative/Agency-Adjacent framing per PRD §3a than pure Home Services)
Group-booking and party-package flows convert better than a single 'book now' — surface Corporate/Stag-Hen/Kids as distinct paths, mirroring their real nav
Weather-dependency is the #1 objection for outdoor recreation — answer it directly in the FAQ, don't bury it
Group size and age/height restrictions belong near the top of any package section — the #1 pre-booking question
local_seo_patterns: One H2 per real scraped package/event type (e.g. Corporate Events, Team Building, Stag & Hen, Kids)
One H2 for the primary location/town from Places
NAP in the footer as text with tel:/mailto:, matching the visible Google Business Profile listing exactly
LocalBusiness JSON-LD subtype: SportsActivityLocation or similar
facebook_ad_angles: Action shot (kart on track) + 'Free instant homepage redesign, see it in 48h'
Group-booking angle: 'Planning a stag/hen/corporate day? See your new site first'
Real review-count trust angle if Places data supports it
trust_signals: Real Google rating + review count from Places — cross-check any on-site review claim (e.g. a banner number) against the real Places figure before using it
Safety equipment / certification mentions only if present in scraped facts
Years in operation only if stated on their existing site
forbidden_slop: Generic stock go-kart photos unrelated to the actual track/venue
"Adrenaline rush", "heart-pumping action" and similar generic extreme-sports cliché copy
Invented review counts or testimonials not present in facts
Invented age/weight/height restrictions not present in facts — verify with the operator before publishing
hero_video_cinematography: low tracking shot following a go-kart around a real track corner at speed, motion blur on the background, golden hour rim lighting, dust or track texture visible in the foreground
faq_seed_questions: How much does it cost per person?
What's the minimum age or height?
How long does a session last?
Do I need to book in advance?
